text_block_list.text:
Having come to watch a race together with 
Mejiro McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Soba, udon, steak. Soft-serve ice 
cream, carrot donuts—"
choice_data_list: What kind of spell is that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No. Some classmates were talking about 
what they call "racecourse gourmet" the 
other day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This junk-food smell packed with 
seasonings. I'd never paid it any mind 
before, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The moment I notice it, it's over— I just 
can't help but be drawn to it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. That flavor everyone's been 
talking about... I can't deny that I'm 
curious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And so! For this matter, I shall ask 
Trainer-san for assistance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Pretending ignorance of the unknown would 
bring shame upon the Mejiro name. How 
about we partake in it together?

Mejiro McQueen makes a suggestion. Every 
dish looks like it'd make you gain weight, 
but—
choice_data_list: If anything, let's eat our fill!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please! Let's split it in half— N-No! 
Just one bite...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I was surprised by the rich seasoning at 
first... but I see now why everyone is 
talking about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A rich, heavy flavor rarely tasted at home 
or the Academy— a single bite, and all 
nutritional balance is struck out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is delicious, but... to put it bluntly, 
it is the mortal enemy of diets. Yes, a 
forbidden flavor! I must be careful not to 
overeat...

Together with Mejiro McQueen, I left the 
scene while shivering.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... No wonder everyone's talking 
about it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
After all, before I knew it, I had eaten 
this much... Ugh, I am so uncomfortably 
full...
choice_data_list: Even after I tried so hard to stop you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
T-That's...! It's all because that junk 
food aroma seduced me—!

Having eaten too much, Mejiro McQueen 
seemed unable to focus on watching the 
race afterwards...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Understood. If it's what you say, 
Trainer, I will follow it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
B-But, some other time, definitely...! 
Learning about the unfamiliar is also the 
duty of the Mejiros!

In any case, Mejiro McQueen seemed to have 
somehow overcome the temptation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What...!? Why would it turn out like 
that?! You know about my constitution... 
don't you?
choice_data_list:
A half-hearted attitude would bring shame 
to the Mejiro name!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wha...!? I see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... You have a point. However, 
reckless binge eating is..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my... Both of you. Are you here to 
watch the races as well?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Ikuno-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, um...—T-That's it! Would you 
care to join me, if you'd like?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I was just thinking... of taking a short 
breather to enjoy some racetrack 
delicacies. ...Isn't that right, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. I was just thinking that I 
could use a break soon myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(A-Alright...! With Ikuno-san watching 
over, it will keep things in check. Plus, 
she knows so much about nutrition...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go check out the food stalls 
right away! I-I'll just have something 
light...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Something light? ...How unexpected. There 
are so many sweet stalls today, I was 
certain you'd be drawn to those.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "Ugh……! Th-That's……"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...The one catching my eye is the low-carb 
crepe. It's wheat-free and rich in 
protein. It has quite the reputation for 
being low in calories yet plenty sweet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! You have something so 
wonderful...!? I would be delighted to 
have some!

And so, Mejiro McQueen thoroughly enjoyed 
the racetrack gourmet alongside Ikuno 
Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That was a blind spot...! You are entirely 
right. Acting as if I know everything 
after merely dabbling would be a disgrace 
to the Mejiro name...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! This is all for future 
reference. Let us partake to our heart's 
content!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hafu, hafu... These are exquisite azuki 
beans. A hint of salt brings out the 
sweetness... and the dough is so crisp and 
fluffy...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Next is cream taiyaki...! The chocolate 
one looks delicious too... I simply must 
have both!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the churros look freshly fried as 
well! What a wonderful aroma... I must get 
in line at once...!

Mejiro McQueen thoroughly enjoyed the 
sweets. Her weight, however, had 
undeniably gone up...
